description_full:
WORKLIT IS HIRING INTERNS!!

Looking for an internship with real work experience? Join us as:

1. Social Media Specialist Intern
2. Marketing Event Intern
3. Business Development Intern
4. Talent Acquisition Intern
5. Learning & Development Intern
6. Admin Intern
7. Public Relations Intern

Work arrangement: Hybrid
Open for: University students (especially final-year) & fresh graduates

What you'll get:
- Real projects, not just watching from the sidelines
- Collaboration with different teams
- Portfolio-worthy work experience

How to apply:
Fill out the form via the link as follows
https://forms.gle/dftUwNm1GTomyija7
